item.title: Law
item.description: Description I discover htmLawed 1.2.5 on port 80 of this lab is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution (RCE). As a result, I am able to gain access to the Linux server as the user ‘www-data’. After gaining access, I then use a script which I have write access to, that is being run as a cronjob by root, to elevate my privileges to root. Skill Learned CVE Exploitation GLPI htmlawed (CVE-2022-35914) Privilege Escalation via cronjob Solution Finding the vulnerability I run autorecon and discovered that both port 22 and 80 open.
